source.note: Replace with exact original source closure and retained codec; the sanitised public export cannot authenticate historical runs. Include additional bound source trees wherever the original binding requires them.

runtime.note: Replace with the original installed runtime prefix including interpreter, packages, native libraries and their dependencies. This is not recreated by installing current versions.

inputs.note: Explicitly select the private authority inputs required by these controls. Empty paths are allowed only here, with an explanation that the selected run has no external input dependency.

provenance.note: Include run configuration, source/environment inventory, acceptance records and restore instructions. Keep this plan, the generated inventory and recovery bundles private.
